title: Preallocate secondary index scan prefixes
description: Replace secondary index prefix format! calls in equality, IN-list, and LIKE fixed-prefix scans with exact-capacity helpers.

criteria: Equality and IN-list prefixes remain index:<table>:<column>:<value>:
LIKE fixed-prefix scan prefix remains index:<table>:<column>:<prefix> without trailing colon
Index and SELECT regression tests pass

notes: The trailing-colon helper is used for exact secondary-index equality and IN-list probes.
The value-start helper intentionally omits the trailing colon for LIKE fixed-prefix scans.
Generated scan prefixes remain byte-for-byte equivalent to the prior format! strings.
